<style>
  h1.title, .title-block { display: none !important; }

  /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     TUNABLE PARAMETER — adjust carousel height here.
     Cards that are taller than this value are clipped rather than
     pushing the page content below the carousel.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  :root { --carousel-height: 420px; }

  /* ── Eyebrow title block ── */
  .eyebrow-title {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1rem;

  }
  .eyebrow-title .eyebrow {

    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #222;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  /* ── Fixed-height carousel: height driven by --carousel-height ── */
  .featured-carousel {
    height: var(--carousel-height);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .carousel-track    { height: 100%; align-items: stretch; }
  .mc-card-container { height: 100%; }
  /* Clip the badge/meta area so long cards don't overflow */
  .mc-card-meta      { overflow: hidden; max-height: 120px; }

  /* ── Capability tiles — pill shape, center-justified ── */
  .capability-tiles {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 880px;
    margin: 0 auto 2rem;
  }
  .cap-tile {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    border: 1.5px solid #e4e7ec;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;
    text-align: center;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  }
  .cap-tile:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(214,64,0,0.12);
    border-color: #D64000;
  }
  .cap-tile .cap-icon { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; }
  .cap-tile strong    { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #D64000; }
  .cap-tile span      { font-size: 13px; color: #555; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* ── Filled oval highlights — non-interactive, no hover effect ── */
  .oval-highlights {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 1.75rem 0;
  }
  .oval-highlights li {
    background: #D64000;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 0.4rem 1.4rem;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: default;        /* not a link — show default arrow cursor */
    pointer-events: none;   /* suppress any inherited hover behaviour */
  }
</style>
